The structure of La2Mg4Cu4 (La(MgCu)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Cu centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Cu, 3 La, 3 Mg) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while La and Mg each have 16 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cu and Mg polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Cu and La polyhedra.
